goal: Finish page256 source/target visual, responsive, interaction and AX acceptance with at most two reused Opera tabs and without repeated full-page/AX captures.
prerequisites: STATE.md has explicitly released PAGE264 ONLY and handed the writable scope to page256.
WPVibe is available on the intended account and a fresh page256 saved-data baseline is reconciled before any target write.
For read-only browser checks that do not depend on a new write, source and target URLs must be verified before evidence is accepted.

memory_policy.navigation: Reuse the same two tab IDs and only change anchor/viewport/state.
memory_policy.ax: Use section-local or literal-targeted AX reads. Never paginate the whole page AX tree unless a specific blocker cannot be isolated.
memory_policy.screenshots: Prefer tight section captures. Do not keep multiple screenshot views or duplicate source/target tabs open.
memory_policy.reloads: At most one deliberate reload per side for a state requiring a clean load; no retry loops on disconnect/504.
memory_policy.interaction_reset: After each interactive check restore the section to its initial tab/FAQ state before moving on.

ordered_checks.viewport: desktop matched source/target, preferably the previously used 1640x920 evidence viewport
ordered_checks.method: section-by-section tight visual/AX check; do not capture the full page repeatedly
must_close: hero vertical rhythm and CTA state
technology card surfaces/checklist and technology icon badge exactness diagnostic
review quote/dot/ordinal visuals plus Panasonic list semantics
stress physical reading order and article role
FAQ-before-CTA order and final mail child order
no breakpoint jump caused by desktop parity blocks
section spacing winning owner measured before any override

reviews: Tab click and ArrowRight/Left/Up/Down/Home/End remain handled by the native Atomic Tabs + af-project path.
Previous/next wraps in source order and the new active tabpanel receives focus; if not, leave exactness blocker open unless a sanctioned physical runtime owner exists.
No duplicate numbered control enters focus order; decorative 01/02/03 produces no standalone AX staticText after ordinal fix.
FAQ: If exact source runtime has a sanctioned owner by then: click and native Enter/Space activation, ArrowRight/Down/Left/Up/Home/End trigger navigation, aria-expanded/controls synchronization and 280ms/220ms motion.
If no sanctioned runtime owner exists, retain functional native details and leave FAQ_exact_runtime explicitly open rather than faking PASS.
anchors: #ugyfelvelemenyek resolves to the review section after anchor microfix.
Existing hero/technology/contact destinations continue to resolve; do not rewrite already-correct links.

stop_conditions: Opera connector disconnects or becomes unstable: stop immediately; do not open replacement tabs.
Target saved/rendered state no longer matches the latest reconciled baseline: stop acceptance and return to saved-data reconciliation.
Any write causes protected copy, IDs, tab relationships, assets or already-closed semantics to drift: rollback only that atomic unit before continuing.
A viewport check cannot distinguish source/cascade ownership: record diagnostic evidence and do not guess a CSS override.
acceptance_rule: PIXEL_PASS and exact PASS remain false until every affected desktop/narrow component is freshly compared in the same browser engine and every hard semantic/runtime blocker is closed or explicitly proven impossible under the current allowed ownership model.
